title: Origins of Go Concurrency style by Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike's 2010 talk at OSCON's Emerging Languages Camp on where Go's concurrency style comes from. It traces the idea from Hoare's CSP through Squeak, Newsqueak and Limbo to Go.
why: HN recommends it as the clearest account of the CSP lineage behind Go's goroutines and channels.
